name: TurboBlitz XT
description: Breathe new life into your childhood with the TurboBlitz XT, a high-performance remote-control car designed for thrill-seekers and motorsport enthusiasts alike. Perfect for fans of off-road racing and stunts, this car is built to take on challenging terrain and deliver unparalleled speed and agility. The TurboBlitz XT features a powerful waterproof motor, advanced transmission system, and durable construction, ensuring a smooth ride and long-lasting performance. Whether you're racing on pavement, dirt, or asphalt, this speed demon is ready to unleash its full potential.

name: Aquaburst Lite
description: Designed specifically for students who spend their free time hiking, cycling, or simply enjoying the outdoors, the Aquaburst Lite is the perfect waterproof jacket for those on-the-go. Key features include a breathable, waterproof membrane that provides exceptional protection from the elements, adjustable cuffs to prevent wind chill, and a comfortable fit with a removable fleece lining for colder weather. The Aquaburst Lite is lightweight and easy to pack, making it the ideal choice for students on the move.

name: VeloxX
description: Upgrade your little one's toy collection with the VeloxX, a high-speed remote-control car perfect for kids aged 6 and above. Its durable design and sturdy construction ensure hours of fun and excitement. Equipped with advanced remote control technology and a long-lasting battery life, this car is ideal for kids looking to explore the world of remote-control vehicles. The VeloxX features a sleek, aerodynamic design, adjustable speed control, and a built-in LED light, adding an extra layer of excitement to its already impressive performance.

name: Kelvax
description: Kelvax is the perfect companion for a night in with friends or family. Suitable for gamers of all ages, this lightweight board game is easy to transport and store. With its compact design and portable size, you can take Kelvax anywhere, making it an ideal choice for game nights on the go. The game features 200 colourful cards, 16 player tokens, and a unique gameplay mechanic that combines strategy and luck. The game box is designed to be compact and lightweight, making it easy to take on holiday or to a friend's house.

name: DuraFlow Pro
description:
Designed for the most demanding professionals, the DuraFlow Pro running watch is engineered to deliver unparalleled performance and durability. Built for long-distance training and competition, this watch features a lightweight titanium casing and a 1.2cm colour display. Optimized for GPS tracking and data analysis, the DuraFlow Pro also includes a built-in heart rate monitor and up to 30 hours of battery life on a single charge, ensuring you stay focused on the finish line.

Key features include GPS tracking, heart rate monitoring, and advanced data analysis. Water-resistant up to 50m, it's the perfect companion for athletes pushing themselves to the limit.

name: Aerius
description: Elevate your cooking game with the Aerius air fryer, perfect for health-conscious individuals and chefs alike. This premium air fryer is designed for those who demand the best - with its advanced digital controls and rapid temperature shifts, you'll achieve perfectly cooked meals every time. Enjoy crispy, golden-brown results with minimal oil. With its compact footprint and sleek design, the Aerius air fryer is ideal for home cooks, entertainers, and busy professionals.

name: Terraka
description: Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts and yogis alike, the Terraka yoga mat is designed for comfort and mobility. Its lightweight construction makes it easy to take on-the-go, while the non-slip surface provides stability and grip on various terrain. Ideal for hikes, camping trips, or simply practicing yoga in the park, the Terraka is a great companion for any outdoor activity. Its compact size and carry strap make it easy to stash in a backpack or bag.

name: Fluxion
description: Upgrade your college cooking game with Fluxion, the perfect kitchen companion for students. This innovative air fryer is designed to make meal prep easy, healthy, and delicious. With its compact size and user-friendly interface, Fluxion is ideal for small kitchens, student apartments, or dorm rooms. Quickly cook a variety of dishes, including crispy fries, succulent chicken, and flavorful vegetables, all with minimal oil and effort. Plus, its sleek design complements any modern kitchen decor.
